description: This file defines a UI component for editing and publishing a Nostr profile, including form state management, rendering logic, and helper functions.

methods.name: isFormDirty
methods.description: Checks if the form has unsaved changes by comparing current values with original values.

methods.description: Initializes form state from an existing profile object or defaults.
